purpose: Recombine the external-liquidity anchor from the previously studied PDH/PDL family with the independently discovered sweep->MSS->OB retest timing sequence, using both PDH and PDL without post-hoc side selection.

source_basis.logic: PDH+PDL sweep/reclaim produced a Stage-A strong pass and later-Jan validation pass but failed Jan-Jul monthly robustness; active promotion retired.
M1 sweep->MSS->OB midpoint timing ordinary-passed at -$0.03 while adding 7 official wins; frozen only as a recombination clue.
Previous-day highs/lows are liquidity areas; liquidity grabs followed by valid structure shifts provide stronger context.
Last opposite candle before structural displacement becomes a rule-based zone retained until mitigation/retest.

common_semantics.levels: previous active UTC day high and low, both retained exactly; no side split
common_semantics.sweep: first completed bar on the configured timeframe that trades beyond PDH/PDL and closes back inside; PDH sweep implies bearish direction, PDL sweep bullish
common_semantics.local_structure: width-2 confirmed swings on the same configured timeframe
common_semantics.mss: after sweep, first completed close beyond the latest confirmed opposite swing that was visible at sweep time
common_semantics.order_block: last opposite-colour completed candle strictly after sweep and before MSS; body zone only
common_semantics.ownership: one setup per PDH/PDL level per UTC day; after first causal sweep that level is consumed whether or not downstream MSS/OB/retest completes
common_semantics.retest: first completed bar after MSS whose range intersects OB body; first interaction consumes zone
common_semantics.proposal: first executable tick at/after retest edge if retest rule passes

R037-PDSM-C01_M1_BODY_TOUCH.retest: first OB-body interaction closes on shift-direction side of midpoint

R037-PDSM-C02_M1_MIDPOINT.retest: first OB-body interaction reaches midpoint and closes on shift-direction side

R037-PDSM-C03_M5_BODY_TOUCH.retest: first OB-body interaction closes on shift-direction side of midpoint

R037-PDSM-C04_M5_MIDPOINT.retest: first OB-body interaction reaches midpoint and closes on shift-direction side

screen_gate.winner_or_quality_gate: official-win delta nonnegative OR positive net with improved gross loss
